title: UI modal for the proof of delivery
body:
This ticket is for the UI change needed for the Proof of delivery in this application

Description
We need a Proof of Delivery (POD) feature in OMS to record and confirm that a customer (or their authorized representative) has picked up an order. This feature should capture proof of identity and generate a confirmation email to the customer.

Requirements / Acceptance Criteria
1. Customer Confirmation at Pickup
Store associate asks the customer to confirm order details at pickup.
Customer provides proof of identity (e.g., ID upload, signature, or unique code).
The system records this confirmation and links it to the order.
2. Email Notification
Once confirmation is saved, an automated email is sent to the customer notifying them that the order has been picked up.
Email should include order details and confirmation of pickup.

title: Add: order handover email support and enhanced status notifications
body:
### Related Issues
<!--  Put related issue number which this PR is closing. For example #123 -->
Closes #[[82](https://github.com/hotwax/hotwax-oms/issues/82#event-20106095834)]
#

### Short Description and Why It's Useful
Added support for sending an order completion (handover) email notification for "Ship to Store" orders using the `HANDOVER_BOPIS_ORDER` notification type.

**Key Changes:**
- **Automated Handover Email:** triggers a handover notification when the final shipgroup of an order is handed over.
- **Enhanced Notifications:** Improved toast feedback for both **Handover** and **Arrived** actions.
- **Support for Split Orders:** Implemented `isLastShipGroup` logic in [ShipToStoreOrders.vue](cci:7://file:///home/yashverma/Ionic/bopis/src/views/ShipToStoreOrders.vue:0:0-0:0) to ensure the completion email is sent only when the entire order is finished, while providing standard "Success" toasts for partial shipgroup actions.

title: Edit Picker” option should be disabled after the order is handed over to the customer
body:
## Current behavior
Edit Picker” option should be disabled after the order is handed over to the customer

## Expected behavior
- Once an order is handed over to the customer, picker assignment should be locked.
- System should not allow modifying picker details for completed/closed orders.

## Steps to reproduce the issue

- Open an order that has already been handed over to the customer.
- Navigate to the picker section.
- Check if the Edit Picker option is available and change the picker.
